Hi -- OK, I tried running it.  The problem wasn't with saving, it was NaNs (Not A Number) in the likelihood calcualtion.

You are getting these NaNs because, somewhere in the likelihood calculation, the data are being given 0 likelihood, i.e. 0 probability.  This causes 0/0 errors and other issues.

If the likelihood is 0, this means your data have 0 probability, which is a big problem, since it means the data are impossible under your proposed model!

The problem is the areas_allowed file, it runs fine if that is commented out.  It is quite easy to set up areas_allowed constraints that make your data impossible.  And, in general, the areas_allowed file is of very limited utility -- it is better to manually modify the states_list for any complex scenario.  And, whatever you do, you have to make sure that you don't create impossible scenarios.

See my previous comments on this in various places:

http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears#areas_allowed_matrix2
http://phylo.wikidot.com/example-biogeobears-scripts#manual_modify_states
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/biogeobears/7bBNhV904f8/_2eBt6PuAAAJ

...or other searches on the Google Group.

Cheers!

Nick
